scheme_name: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child
other_conditions: Must be the only girl child in the family (no brothers or sisters); twins are also eligible
Must be enrolled in a regular full‑time Ph.D. programme; part‑time or distance modes are not eligible
Must be pursuing a Ph.D. in any recognised university/college/institute
Must be aged up to 40 years for general category or up to 45 years for SC/ST/OBC/PWD applicants
Must provide an affidavit on ₹100 stamp paper, attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate/Tahsildar, proving single‑girl‑child status
benefits_summary: Provides a five‑year research fellowship with a monthly stipend of ₹31,000 (JRF) for the first two years and ₹35,000 (SRF) thereafter, plus contingency and housing assistance.
documents_required: Affidavit on ₹100 stamp paper attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate/Tahsildar proving single‑girl‑child status
